fixes.explanation: Enemies are a natural guess, friend, but this verse doesn't name them. The prayer says, “And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.” (Matthew 6:13) I get it, I spent years in a junk drawer and I still wanted to blame the rubber band. Jesus points the request at the evil one, not at the neighbor, the boss or anybody else.
